categories.main_business_segments: SMIC primarily operates as a semiconductor foundry, providing integrated circuit (IC) wafer foundry and technology services on 8-inch and 12-inch wafers. The company also offers supporting services including design services, IP support, and photomask manufacturing, aiming to provide a full range of integrated circuit solutions through collaboration with upstream and downstream industry partners.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SMIC utilizes advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies across multiple technology nodes and platforms, including logic IC, power/analog, high-voltage driver, embedded non-volatile memory, RF, and CMOS image sensors. The company follows a structured R&D process with stages from project selection to mass production, emphasizing process innovation, platform development, and technology iteration. Production involves small-batch trial production, risk production, and mass production phases, with strict quality and process controls.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SMIC serves global customers in various sectors including smartphones, computers and tablets, consumer electronics, connectivity and IoT, industrial, and automotive markets. Its customer base includes IC design companies and IDM companies worldwide, with strategic partnerships in consumer electronics, automotive, IoT, industrial control, and AI sectors. The company focuses on meeting diverse market demands with differentiated technology platforms.
categories.geographic_coverage: SMIC operates primarily in the Chinese Mainland with manufacturing facilities in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and other locations. It maintains an international presence with marketing offices and service bases in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Taiwan. The majority of revenue is generated from China (approximately 85%), with additional sales in America and Eurasia.
categories.supply_chain_position: SMIC operates as a midstream semiconductor foundry in the supply chain, manufacturing wafers for IC design companies and IDMs. It also engages in upstream collaborations through design services and photomask manufacturing, and downstream partnerships with packaging and testing companies, forming an integrated ecosystem within the semiconductor industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on expanding and optimizing technology platforms such as 28nm ULL, 55nm HV display driver, 65nm RF-SOI, and 90nm BCD technologies. SMIC invests significantly in R&D (about 9.5% of revenue), aiming to improve process performance, reduce power leakage, and develop specialty process technologies for automotive and industrial applications. It also emphasizes ecosystem collaboration, supply chain integration, and talent development to sustain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: SMIC generates revenue mainly through direct sales of semiconductor wafers and related foundry services. Revenue is recognized primarily at the point of goods transfer, with additional income from supporting services such as design, IP support, and photomask manufacturing. The company’s revenue is driven by wafer shipments and product mix, with a focus on high-volume mass production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SMIC is ranked as the second largest pure-play foundry globally and the leading foundry in the Chinese Mainland. It competes with global industry leaders but faces a technological gap and lower market share compared to the top-tier foundries. The company leverages its scale, comprehensive service offerings, and local market leadership to maintain a strong competitive position amid intense global competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SMIC reported revenue of approximately USD 8.03 billion, a 27% increase year-over-year, with gross margin at 18% and capacity utilization at 85.6%. The company shipped over 8 million standard logic 8-inch equivalent wafers, reflecting a 36.7% increase in shipment volume. Total assets reached USD 49.2 billion, and the company continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, indicating a growth trajectory despite profit fluctuations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SMIC emphasizes its comprehensive technology platforms, one-stop foundry and supporting services, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. The company offers diversified technology nodes tailored to various end markets, backed by a robust intellectual property portfolio and internationalized supply chain. Its value proposition includes high-quality manufacturing, rapid product introduction, customer-centric service, and ecosystem collaboration to meet evolving market demands.
